normalization_plan.reason: owner_ is only consumed by DSAuth.setOwner to write the owner state variable
_admin is only consumed by the admin rotation functions to write the admin state variable
_data is only forwarded by callExecute into the external DSProxy.execute call
_txData is only forwarded by callProxy into the proxy execute call
_proxy is only used by callProxy to resolve the proxy owner before execution
_amount is only used as the base value for the fee division inside getFee
_user is only used by getFee for the discount registry lookup
_cdpId is only used by unsubscribe to locate the position to remove

the feeAmount local only holds the intermediate fee result of getFee
